kpis.description_fr: Revenu CCG (PC processors). Cœur historique du CA Intel. Reprise modeste post-creux 2022/23 + cycle AI PC.
kpis.description_en: Client Computing Group (CCG) revenue (PC processors). Intel's historical core. Modest recovery post 2022/23 trough + AI PC cycle.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu DCAI (Xeon CPU + accélérateurs Gaudi). Recul long-terme face NVDA + AMD sur AI accelerators. Cible de turnaround Gelsinger.
kpis.description_en: DCAI revenue (Xeon CPU + Gaudi accelerators). Long-term decline vs NVDA + AMD on AI accelerators. Gelsinger turnaround target.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu Intel Foundry (manufacturing). Inclut wafers internes + clients externes (IFS). Stratégie 5N4Y pour rattraper TSMC.
kpis.description_en: Intel Foundry revenue (manufacturing). Includes internal wafers + external clients (IFS). 5N4Y strategy to catch up with TSMC.

kpis.description_fr: Capex (en M$). Cycle d'investissement massif pour fabs Arizona/Ohio/Israel. Pression sur free cash flow.
kpis.description_en: Capex (in $M). Massive investment cycle for Arizona/Ohio/Israel fabs. Pressure on free cash flow.

_notes: Intel reporting redesign post 1H24 = Intel Products (CCG, DCAI, NEX) + Intel Foundry séparés. KPIs spécifiques alignés sur cette structure + Capex (signature stratégique Gelsinger). Source 2024 annual report cat3-european.

kpis_story.description_fr: Montée en production du noeud 18A (Intel 18A, nouveau processus angstrom-scale) en 2025 : pari technologique critique pour reprise leadership.
kpis_story.description_en: Ramp-up of 18A node (Intel 18A, new angstrom-scale process) in 2025: critical technological bet for leadership recovery.
